title: EYELN - Play To Yield NFT Game
tagline: A Play to Yield NFT Crypto Game. Own and claim your EYELN Tokens.
description: A play to yield crypto game. The current NFT space has been mostly holding tokens. The goal of this project is to incentivize to buying and selling. The more active the project is, the higher the yield. Even though this is an island (EYELN), the project needs a community to thrive.
how_its_made:
- ChainSafe Gaming: An SDK that connects game engines to the blockchain.

- IPFS Stores NFT metadata

- Polygon network: stores game logic and state

- Pocket Network: for RPC calls

- Skynet: to host game using github actions and resolver link

- Radicle: open source code is stored on Radicle



For more detailed explanation, please watch a demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GwZkxzHWo5U
